subject: Results of the Harbour Bikes public bike share in July, August and September 2026, and plans for 2027

cover.subtitle: More riders, fewer empty docks, and what we plan for 2027

agenda.note: Twenty minutes, then questions. The figures are for 1 July to 30 September 2026.

items.text: **The quarter in four numbers.** Trips, riders, availability and income.
**Where people ride.** Trips by district, and the new waterfront stations.
**Fleet and docks.** E-bikes, repairs and rebalancing.
**2027.** The three projects we ask the board to approve.

figures.title: The quarter in four numbers
figures.note: August broke the record for a single month, with 151,200 trips. Rain on eleven days in September brought the quarter back to the forecast.

districts.title: Where people ride
districts.chart_title: Trips starting in each district, in thousands

callout.title: Waterfront
paragraphs: The six stations opened in June already start one trip in four of the district’s total.
Busiest dock: **Ferry Terminal**, with 610 trips a day in August.

fleet.title: Fleet and docks

rows.item: Bikes moved by van to rebalance docks

fleet.note: Rebalancing fell by a fifth after the new pricing rewarded trips that end at empty docks.
